aal-bing-2.webp.zh: 奥尔堡机场航站楼正面：低矮的雨棚由一排立柱撑起，入口藏在玻璃幕墙后面。
aal-bing-2.webp.en: The front of Aalborg Airport's terminal — a low canopy carried on a row of columns, with the glazed entrance behind it.

aal-bing-3.webp.en: Boarding on the apron: passengers climbing the stairs to an Atlantic Airways jet while ground crew stand by.
